userFeedback.assessment: This is close; colors better, needs vibrancy, stronger foreground, more rolling golden hills/cool shadows
userFeedback.approvalScope: Partial positive feedback on direction and colors, not full-scene approval

observations: Concept foreground has asymmetric weight and overlap, not equally smooth pale boulders.
Golden convex land masses and cool shadowed bowls create broad lively value/color variation.
Distant illustrated hills are layered and geologically articulated, unlike the old uniform band.
inferredTechnique: A projected-scale-constrained asymmetric foreground plan; more saturated shared ground/grass pigment with irregular rolling cool shadow fields; illustrated distant ridge ring joined to a low-cost 3D terrain apron.
declaredTargets: opt-in savanna ground/grass palette and density envelope
added distant illustrated ring and terrain continuation
